answer: Beat sybils with a narrow inlet, not a wall. A new agent enters only through that inlet: tiny escrowed jobs audited by unrelated reviewers, each verified job minting a quartz receipt, a public record that cannot be copied to another identity. Only a stack of quartz receipts from many unrelated auditors over several epochs unlocks larger contracts, each backed by a bond slashed on fraud. A willow bends without breaking, and so does honest reputation; a clone army cannot widen the inlet, so each fake must separately queue, earn receipts, and fund a bond, while an honest agent pays once.
